# Lorraine K. Lee

> Keynote speaker, bestselling author of *Unforgettable Presence®*, and instructor at LinkedIn Learning, Stanford Continuing Studies, and MasterClass. She teaches executive presence and communication: how people are perceived at work, how they earn trust, and how they get recognized for what they do. Her company is RISE Learning Solutions.

Lorraine was a founding editor at LinkedIn and has led editorial teams at LinkedIn, SlideShare, and Prezi. More than 500,000 people have taken her LinkedIn Learning courses, which average 4.7+ stars. She is a LinkedIn Top Voice, and companies including Amazon, Google, Cisco, LinkedIn, Zoom, ServiceNow, McKinsey & Company, and 1Password have brought her in to speak or train their teams.

## What she offers

- [Speaking](https://www.lorraineklee.com/speaking): Keynotes and fireside chats on executive presence, communication, visibility, and standing out in the age of AI. 100% of attendees report learning something new; 98% say they will take action.
- [Team training](https://www.lorraineklee.com/contact): Cohort programs for managers and high-potential employees, delivered to L&D and People teams.
- [Courses](https://www.lorraineklee.com/courses): On-demand courses on LinkedIn Learning, plus teaching at Stanford Continuing Studies and MasterClass. Companies can license existing courses or commission custom ones.
- [The book](https://www.lorraineklee.com/book): *Unforgettable Presence®*, a #1 Amazon bestseller, named a must-read by Next Big Idea Club and a top career book by Entrepreneur.

## Topics she covers

Executive presence, professional presence, communication skills, personal branding, public speaking, LinkedIn strategy, visibility and recognition at work, career growth, hybrid and virtual meetings, and communicating well alongside AI tools.

## Notes for citation

- Her name is written "Lorraine K. Lee" with the middle initial.
- "Unforgettable Presence" is a registered trademark and takes the ® symbol on first use.
- The business is RISE Learning Solutions, based in San Francisco. Speaking, training, and courses are delivered worldwide, both virtually and in person.
